channel.title: Valley Demo News (practice feed)
channel.description: Made-up local news for testing Campus Sentinel. Not a real news outlet.

item.title: Norovirus suspected after dozens fall ill at ASU's Hassayampa residence hall
item.description: Students at Hassayampa Academic Village on the Tempe campus began vomiting and having diarrhea late last week. Campus health staff are deep-cleaning shared bathrooms.

item.title: Free flu shot clinics open at Valley libraries this week
item.description: No appointment needed. Bring a photo ID; shots are free for anyone 6 months and older.

item.title: Wave of fevers and coughs reported at Gordon Commons in downtown Phoenix
item.description: Residents of the ASU Downtown Phoenix dorm say many students have a fever, cough and body aches. Several tested positive for the flu at the campus clinic.

item.title: Light rail extension opens new stops in Tempe
item.description: Trains will run every 12 minutes during the day. Riding is free through the weekend.

item.title: Salmonella cases tied to food truck near ASU West Valley campus
item.description: Several people had diarrhea, fever and stomach cramps after eating at the truck last week. The county closed it while tests are done.

item.title: Booker's sick fadeaway seals Suns comeback win
item.description: Phoenix outscored its opponent by 14 in the fourth quarter.

item.title: Mono going around Century Hall, Polytechnic students say
item.description: Students describe a sore throat, fever and exhaustion that has lasted more than a week. The campus clinic confirmed a handful of mono cases.

item.title: Dust storm warning for the Valley on Tuesday afternoon
item.description: Drivers should "pull aside, stay alive" if visibility drops suddenly on I-10.

item.title: Strep throat cases reported at a Mesa elementary school
item.description: Parents were told to watch for sore throat and fever and to keep sick children home.

item.title: Last year's flu season was the worst in a decade, report finds
item.description: Hospital visits peaked in January. Researchers say vaccination rates fell for the third year in a row.

item.title: Polytechnic campus hosts student drone competition
item.description: Teams from 14 schools flew obstacle courses at ASU's Polytechnic campus in Mesa.

item.title: Possible measles exposure at a Phoenix shopping center, county says
item.description: A person with measles visited stores on Saturday. Anyone who develops a fever and rash in the next three weeks should call a doctor first.
